data_types.name: Source media file
data_types.description: Original uploaded audio/video file (MP4, M4A, MP3, WAV, AAC, FLAC, OGG, WMA)
data_types.export_boundary: Managed local storage only — never uploaded to external service
data_types.deletion_mechanism: Job DELETE endpoint; file removed from disk

data_types.name: Transcript text
data_types.description: Whisper output — plain text transcription; may contain PHI, PII, BHI, or BII depending on source audio
data_types.export_boundary: User-initiated download only; not transmitted to external service

data_types.name: Audit derivation tree
data_types.description: Encrypted append-only derivation tree — SHA-256 hashes only, no transcript text. Sole purpose: product defensibility per AUDIT_SINGLE_PURPOSE_PRINCIPLE.md.
data_types.export_boundary: CATEGORICALLY PROHIBITED — sole purpose is product defensibility per ADR-007 and AUDIT_SINGLE_PURPOSE_PRINCIPLE.md. Prohibited uses include: analytics, telemetry, benchmarking, AI training, third-party transfer.
data_types.deletion_mechanism: Survives job deletion; write_deletion() records deletion event in tree. Deletion of audit tree itself requires retention floor (STS_AUDIT_MIN_RETENTION_DAYS) to be reached and explicit IT action — application never self-deletes.

data_types.name: Job metadata
data_types.description: Job status, filename, created_at, language, model — no transcript content
data_types.export_boundary: API read-only; not exported to files

data_types.name: Application event log
data_types.description: Existing plaintext audit event log in STS_DATA_DIR/audit/ — job lifecycle events, no transcript text
data_types.gap: Retention and encryption policy for event log not yet implemented. ADR required before QG-03 closes.

gap: DLP matrix is draft. Records owner approval required before QG-05 closes. DT-03 export prohibition enforced by code (no-export guard in ADR-007) and governance; PQAPS must verify before QG-03/QG-05 close.
